caption: The drawing depicts a single powder horn with detailed engravings on its surface. The horn is curved, tapering from a wider base at the bottom to a narrower spout at the top, which has a simple stopper or cap. The surface of the horn is decorated with a map-like design, featuring boundaries, landforms, small figures, and a large sun motif near the center. The colors in the drawing are predominantly shades of brown, ivory, and beige, with fine black lines used for the engraving details. The base of the horn is capped with a darker brown rounded piece, fitted with a metal ring for attachment. The entire object is presented on a plain, light-colored background with no additional items or features.
title: Powder Horn
